prior handoff failure: requested implementation, delivered documentation

tasks.title: Implement judgment closure contract and evaluator
inputs: P04 upstream resolution and runtime-partition contract
acceptanceCriteria: Reject documentation substitution as complete implementation
Reject delegation of safe authorized current-runtime actions
Require evidence-linked CLOSED decisions or falsifiable CONDITIONAL branches
Preserve partial results instead of upgrading proof
Fail closed on absent authority and missing evidence

acceptanceCriteria: Run positive, negative, conditional and tampered-reference canaries
Assert a long sophisticated plan cannot equal tested implementation

Run independent implementation and existing public plan validation

acceptanceCriteria: CI runs focused tests and existing public plans

outputs: runtime-backed handoff admission receipt and consumer integration validation
